dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Uh, hi, umm ... I need to report something a little strange.
{WHAT'S YOUR NAME?}Ok, what's your name?
I'm Nellie Watson.
{WHAT HAPPENED?}So Nelly, why did you call 911?
There's this... drone that's buzzing around the neighborhood.
{IT'S NORMAL} Well, that's not uncommon. They are pretty much everywhere nowadays.
Maybe but it shouldn't attack people!
{ATTACK?} Attack people?! Is this an emergency situation?
Well, I don't know if it's an emergency, but it's... swooping on things! Like next door's cat!
{IS IT AGGRESSIVE?} Swooping'. I see. So someone is flying this drone aggressively then?
Yeah, I guess so. I dunno who though? Maybe that damned Henderson kid... AAAH!
{HELLO?}Hello? Ma'am what happened?
It snuck up from behind me. It's right above my head now. This is spooky, this is wrong. I don't like this.
{IS IT A PRANK?}Sounds like someone is playing a prank.
Well I don't find it funny. This thing has blades. It can hurt. What about the children? Think of the children!
{I'LL SEND THE POLICE} Alright I'm sending the police. They will be there shortly.
{ADDRESS?}What's your address?
I'm in [[ADDRESS]].
I' am at 35 Pine Street
I' am at 255 Oak Street
I' am at 54 1st Street
Ok, thank you, be quick please.
So? Can you help me get rid of this thing? Please?
Are you there? It's still flying around.
{DID IT ATTACK YOU?} Ma'am did the drone attack you or anyone around you?
No bu.. EEEP! It's chasing me! NO! Go AWAY!
{STAY CALM} Please try to stay calm.
Wwaah arrgh I don't like this.
{HIDE} Ma'am can you inside somewhere take shelter from the somewhere?
Ok � a shed, I'll hide in there.
{IT'S NOT AN EMERGENCY} Ma'am, your matter is not life threatening and doesn't require emergency assistance. Please deal with the drone yourself.
I do need help! But you don't want to help me! Goodbye!

reportElement.texten: Caller reported dangerous drone flying in proximity.
Machine endangered locals, the police unit was dispatched to take care of the situation.
Operator ignored the drone situation. No unit was dispatched.
The operator provided caller with instructions to hide from dangerous situation. Police unit was dispatched.
